name: The St. Regis Astana
insider_take: The St. Regis Astana stands as a beacon of luxury in Kazakhstan's futuristic capital, where gleaming skyscrapers meet the vast Central Asian steppes.
whats_special: This ultra-modern hotel is perfectly positioned to explore Nur-Sultan's (formerly Astana) architectural marvels, including the iconic Bayterek Tower and the Norman Foster-designed Khan Shatyr Entertainment Center - the world's largest tent. The city was built from scratch in the 1990s as Kazakhstan's new capital, creating a stunning blend of traditional Kazakh culture and cutting-edge design.
pro_tip: Visit during the brief summer months (June-August) when temperatures are pleasant and the city's numerous parks and outdoor attractions are at their best - winters here can drop to -40°F!
dont_miss: The nearby Hazret Sultan Mosque, one of Central Asia's largest mosques, and the Presidential Palace area with its golden government buildings. Take a sunset trip to Bayterek Tower's observation deck for panoramic views of this remarkable planned city rising from the Kazakh steppes.
pros: Iconic St. Regis butler service and luxury amenities
Modern property in Kazakhstan's dynamic capital city
Access to Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits
Strategic location for business and government district access
cons: Limited local dining and entertainment options in immediate area
